# orq_projects (Data Source)

Lists projects in the workspace bound to the provider credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lists every project visible to the provider credential (newest first).
data "orq_projects" "all" {}

# Project ids, keyed by name, for wiring other resources.
output "project_ids_by_name" {
  value = { for p in data.orq_projects.all.projects : p.name => p.id }
}

# Only the non-archived projects.
output "active_project_keys" {
  value = [for p in data.orq_projects.all.projects : p.key if !p.is_archived]
}
```

- `projects` (Attributes List) Projects visible to the credential, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the project is archived.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the workspace default project.
- `key` (String) Stable project key.
- `name` (String) Project name.
